description: Join Williamson County Democratic Women as we celebrate women running for office and thank them for stepping up to the plate. We've still got a lot of work to do before Election Day, but for tonight we'll stamp and label postcards over a glass of wine, cocktail, or NA bev and enjoy being together. F
